request.style: English, bright female solo voice, acoustic guitar, ukulele, celesta, light percussion, warm and inviting, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ten sons of Benjamin stand in the list
Bela and Becher and Ashbel too
Gera and Naaman follow the line
Ehi is named among the few
Rosh and Muppim and Huppim and Ard
Names written in the sacred scroll
Jacob's family gathering tight
Ready to follow Joseph's call

[Chorus]
Settled in the best part of the land
Food provided for every child
Pharaoh commanded the dwelling place
Peace found in the Goshen field

[Verse]
Sixty-six souls came with Jacob
Plus two born to Joseph in Egypt
Seventy persons in total count
Going down where the famine was
Joseph gave property to his kin
In the district of Rameses they stayed
Clans of Benjamin recorded well
Ahiramite clan stands apart

[Chorus]
Settled in the best part of the land
Food provided for every child
Pharaoh commanded the dwelling place
Peace found in the Goshen field

[Bridge]
From Bela to Ashbel to Ahiram
The census counts the men again
Shupham and Hupham keep their names
A legacy for future days

[Outro]
Ehi son of Benjamin
Remembered in the genealogy
